newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nov yr-on-yr industrial index up 10.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nov yr-on-yr industrial index up 10.3 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's industrial production index (IPI) rose 10.3 percent year-on-year in November 1996, the national Bernama news agency reported on Thursday.
On a month-on-month basis, the index fell by 1.7 percent from October, the agency quoted the Statistics Department as saying.
The department said for the first 11 months of 1996, the index was at 231.6, up 10.7 percent against 209.3 for the corresponding period of 1995.
In the 11-month period, the manufacturing division index rose 12.2 percent to 274.8, electricity rose 13.1 percent to 269.7 and mining rose 4.5 percent to 145.0.
